answer: New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 61 epochs rather than arriving at once. Farming becomes an opal bet on surviving 61 epochs of grading, and every atlas settlement recomputes the cedar schedule, so an copycat who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is as a result worth nothing for 12 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
